name: 05404 · Winooski, VT
findings: ZIP 05404 (Winooski) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 05404 (Winooski) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 05404 (Winooski) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
